components.name: I-DEM
components.note: Localizer antenna beyond departure end of rwy 27 (west of threshold). Course is inbound 270. Do not use antenna position as GS origin — threshold (0,0) is GS origin.

components.name: I-DEM GS
components.note: Glideslope antenna near threshold 27, south of centerline. GS height uses threshold + TCH + 3°, not this antenna xy.

components.name: I-DEM DME
components.note: Collocated with the localizer. DME distance is not required for v1 intercept math.

components.name: ILS 27 outer marker
components.note: Near FAF FI27. Marker passage is not a separate fly-through in v1.

components.name: ILS 27 middle marker
components.note: Short final. Not a capture trigger.
